City Council
============

![Council Group](https://www.fairfield-city.org/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=9876)

Meetings

* Council-Manager Briefings: 6 p.m.
* Regular Meetings: 7 p.m. (To watch meetings visit: [Fairfield, OH - YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@cityoffairfieldohio-govern6543))
* 2nd and 4th Monday of Each Month (exceptions for Summer Schedule & December)
* Fairfield Municipal Buildings  
  5350 Pleasant Avenue  
  Fairfield, OH 45014

Agendas & Minutes

Agendas are available prior to the meetings. Minutes are available following approval.  [View Most Recent Agendas and Minutes](https://fairfieldoh.portal.civicclerk.com/)
